lines.text: The Israelites observed the Passover in the Wilderness of Sinai at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.
Some men unclean due to a dead body came before Moses and Aaron and asked why they should be excluded.
Moses told them to wait, and the LORD said the unclean or traveling could still keep the Passover.
They were to eat the lamb on the fourteenth day of the second month, with unleavened bread and hyssop.
Skipping Passover while clean and not traveling meant being stoned, and a foreigner is to follow the same statute.
